references.text: God remembered his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, demonstrating his faithfulness to the covenant with the ancestors.
God established his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and remembered the covenant when he heard Israel's cry for help.
Describes how the Lord led the Israelites out of Egypt, as mentioned in Leviticus 26:45.
God identifies himself as the one who brought Israel out of Egypt to be their God.
God's covenant with Abraham to be his God and the God of his descendants.
God brought Israel out of Egypt to be their God, emphasizing his demand for holiness.
God brought Israel out of Egypt to be their God, a restatement of the foundation of the covenant.
God will not forget the covenant with the ancestors, a promise of God's faithfulness.
God keeps his covenant and shows loyalty to those who love him.
God remembered his covenant for their sake and relented according to his great compassion.
God remembers his covenant forever, the covenant he made with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
God will remember his covenant from the days of youth and establish an eternal covenant.
Zechariah praises God who remembers his holy covenant, the oath he swore to Abraham.
